purpose: Map the v74 bereavement demand/friction signal into permanent regressions in the same Stödassistenten learning system.

mappings.product_miss: The canonical source/truth layer already knew Pensionsmyndigheten survivor_support, but the public product had no focused first-action route for a death in the family, allowing practical estate steps, partner/child survivor support and work-related-death questions to collapse into generic guidance.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Extend the same actor_type=relative person route with focus=bereavement and one bounded bereavement_context; when context is unknown ask at most one route-changing first-action question, preserve overview as a non-looping choice, and never infer benefit entitlement, inheritance, estate authority or work-injury status from free text.
mappings.truth_boundary: Community discovery and product feedback are learning signals only. Material survivor-benefit, child-support, work-related-death, estate-process, amount, deadline and authority claims must be verified against current responsible primary sources before use.
